purpose: Mine distinct papal writings for character-relevant evidence and attach to existing conversation families instead of producing more Catechism-derived Q&A or duplicating the independent voice pipeline.
sourceCaveats: Documents are papal encyclicals, but not necessarily every embedded quotation: when Pius X cites Scripture, Gregory, or other saints, the quoted words belong to that cited author.
English Vatican pages used to locate passages; original Italian/Latin/French and first-publication collation still required for authentication of specific wording.
Summaries are editorial abstracts, not quotations and not historically reconstructed first-person conversation.
Do not infer that absent from the 48-question expansion means absent from all source registries, voice files, or other working branches.
The end-user period voice, especially personal first-person memory, requires separate review. Historical disciplinary provisions must never be transferred to present law.
Existing 1905/1912/Salzano catechism material, Mass Ultra Master and Chanoine routing owners not modified.

records.theme: Personal devotion expressed in a published encyclical
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: In describing the Immaculate Conception anniversary, Pius X explicitly recalls the devotion and gratitude he himself has long cherished toward the Blessed Virgin.
records.conversationThemeEN: Papal devotion; documentary first-person statement; avoid invented private episodes
records.conversationThemeFR: Dévotion mariale du pape ; témoignage de l'encyclique, sans souvenirs privés inventés

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X presents devotion to Mary as a way to union with Christ, explicitly rooting its purpose in restoration of all things in Christ.
records.conversationThemeEN: Why Mary leads believers to Christ
records.conversationThemeFR: Pourquoi la dévotion mariale conduit au Christ

records.theme: God alone as productive source of grace
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X distinguishes the productive power of grace, belonging to God alone, from Mary's subordinate participation and intercessory ministry; his merit distinction is the historical theological terminology of the encyclical.
records.conversationThemeEN: What Mary can and cannot be said to do in the order of grace
records.conversationThemeFR: Le rôle subordonné de Marie et Dieu comme source de la grâce

records.theme: True devotion evidenced by Christian conduct
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X contrasts festive external Marian honours with inward conversion and obedience to Christ; he invokes the command of Mary at Cana.
records.conversationThemeEN: Marian devotion that affects one's actual life
records.conversationThemeFR: Dévotion mariale et réforme concrète de la vie chrétienne

records.theme: Pastoral model of Gregory amid papal anxieties
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X expressly describes his own worries at the beginning of the pontificate and turns to Gregory the Great as an example of firm yet charitable pastoral government.
records.conversationThemeEN: How a Pope sought encouragement from an earlier Pope
records.conversationThemeFR: Comment Pie X prenait exemple sur saint Grégoire le Grand

records.theme: Proper historical criticism not rejected as such
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: The encyclical criticises historical methods that exclude the supernatural in advance; it also explicitly says sound critical inquiry can be a legitimate instrument of investigation.
records.conversationThemeEN: Can historical criticism ever help faith?
records.conversationThemeFR: La critique historique peut-elle être légitime ?

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X describes the ministry as instructing minds and forming virtue, joined to practical charity that consoles affliction and relieves need.
records.conversationThemeEN: Why preaching must be accompanied by actual charity
records.conversationThemeFR: Pourquoi joindre la charité effective à la prédication

records.theme: Interior piety as a condition for fruitful ministry
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Using Gregory as a model, Pius X teaches that pastoral energy without an interior life with Christ and solid piety is insufficient.
records.conversationThemeEN: The inner life behind pastoral action
records.conversationThemeFR: La vie intérieure et la fécondité pastorale

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X expresses fear of the account he must render to Christ for the people entrusted to him and describes constant solicitude for the flock.
records.conversationThemeEN: How Pius X understood the burden of governing souls
records.conversationThemeFR: Le poids de la responsabilité du pape envers les âmes

records.theme: Vocation discerned, not claimed as a right
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: The encyclical says priesthood is not a worldly occupation that an aspirant may claim as an entitlement; bishops must exercise prudence in examining suitability.
records.conversationThemeEN: How the Church should discern priestly vocations
records.conversationThemeFR: Le discernement prudent des vocations sacerdotales

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X connects biblical and theological study, spiritual direction and solid piety to priestly preparation, alongside specific 1906 Italian institutional restrictions.
records.conversationThemeEN: Why priestly training joins learning and holiness
records.conversationThemeFR: Pourquoi la formation du prêtre unit étude et piété

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X commends ministry among ordinary people: spiritual teaching, strengthening adult Christian life and encouraging institutions benefiting moral and material welfare, while requiring conformity to historical ecclesiastical discipline.
records.conversationThemeEN: Priests and the spiritual and material welfare of working people
records.conversationThemeFR: Les prêtres et le bien spirituel et matériel du peuple

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: The encyclical recounts enslavement, theft, beatings and massacres against Indigenous peoples in South America and condemns these acts, including wrongdoing by professed Christians noted from Benedict XIV's precedent.
records.conversationThemeEN: What Pius X wrote about enslavement and abuse
records.conversationThemeFR: Ce que Pie X écrivit contre l'esclavage et les violences

records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X describes initially finding atrocity reports difficult to believe, then accepting them after testimony from bishops, apostolic delegates, missionaries and other credible witnesses.
records.conversationThemeEN: How he weighed testimony about distant injustices
records.conversationThemeFR: Comment il examina les témoignages sur des injustices lointaines

records.theme: Human fraternity and charity in deeds
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: Pius X instructs bishops to preach and practice Christian charity toward everyone regardless of national origin or colour, demanding practical action against exploitation.
records.conversationThemeEN: Christian charity across national and racial divisions
records.conversationThemeFR: La charité chrétienne sans distinction d'origine et manifestée par des actes

records.theme: Practical protection and prohibition of slave trading
records.sourceSupportedSummaryEN: The encyclical describes establishing additional missions as places of protection; it also explicitly condemns trafficking and deprivation of freedom. Its reservation of absolution for specified crimes is historical ecclesiastical discipline.
records.conversationThemeEN: Concrete measures for victims alongside formal condemnation
records.conversationThemeFR: Mesures concrètes de protection et condamnation de la traite
